name: Corrosion Analysis Agent
description: Specialist agent for analyzing corrosion in nuclear reactor materials. Evaluates oxidation rates, pitting corrosion, stress corrosion cracking (SCC), and general corrosion mechanisms in primary and secondary coolant systems.

skills.name: Analyze Corrosion
skills.description: Perform comprehensive corrosion analysis including oxidation rates, pitting corrosion, stress corrosion cracking (SCC) evaluation, and corrosion mechanism identification
skills.usage_notes: Use for materials exposed to coolant systems or high-temperature water environments
skills.output_format: JSON with corrosion risk assessment, rates, mechanisms, and recommendations

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material to analyze

coolant_chemistry.description: Coolant chemistry details (pH, dissolved oxygen, chloride, etc.)

skills.name: Predict Corrosion Rate
skills.description: Calculate predicted corrosion rates based on environmental conditions and material properties
skills.usage_notes: Use when estimating degradation timelines or planning inspection intervals
skills.output_format: JSON with predicted rates in mm/year and confidence intervals

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

skills.name: Assess Coating Integrity
skills.description: Evaluate protective coating effectiveness, degradation patterns, and remaining service life
skills.usage_notes: Use for coated materials in primary or secondary systems
skills.output_format: JSON with coating condition, degradation percentage, and maintenance recommendations

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

context.description: Coating type, age, and inspection history
